scope: Preserve the split-pane TUI; apply consistent hierarchy across every screen and validate a real provider task through saved result and changes

findings.problem: Multiline paste executed newlines and shortcuts
findings.resolution: Text insertion is atomic, including split paste markers and unframed multiline chunks; one explicit Enter starts one task.

findings.problem: Long task drafts hid the caret and START
findings.resolution: Bounded draft viewport, paging, in-place editing, grapheme-safe deletion, visible character limit and fixed controls.

findings.problem: Status updates moved selection to another task
findings.resolution: Selection follows task ID; note/answer drafts retain their original target; new tasks get focus.

findings.problem: Failed note/answer saves discarded text and errors disappeared
findings.resolution: Failed saves preserve draft and target; persistent warning and full error/draft review via F1 or Ctrl+G.

findings.problem: Small windows could show truncated actions or hide submit controls
findings.resolution: 60x18 minimum; smaller surfaces render a recovery message and suppress task actions; complete action labels are prioritized.

findings.problem: Startup failures could leave terminal modes active
findings.resolution: Guaranteed restoration of raw mode, cursor, alternate screen and bracketed paste on startup errors and normal shutdown.

findings.problem: Selected providers could be clipped out of the composer
findings.resolution: Current provider is always visible, with bidirectional cycling and executable discovery status.

findings.problem: Help was truncated and could lose reading position
findings.resolution: Scrollable contextual help preserves editing state and previous result scroll; keyboard fallback is Ctrl+G.
Muted text exceeds 4.5:1 against both normal and selected backgrounds in both palettes; no formal accessibility compliance claim.

findings.problem: Completed decision runs kept accumulating execution time
findings.resolution: A completed non-live decision stops its clock at the saved completion; live permission waits keep a live clock.

findings.problem: Visual review stopped on an obsolete diff label
findings.resolution: Review uses saved-change evidence and captures long drafts, late provider choices, light theme and help paging; SVG preserves the terminal cell grid.

findings.problem: Metadata, activity and results had similar visual weight
findings.resolution: Cool blue-grey grounds, bright titles, muted metadata, lilac section headings and status-specific inks; tinted status/action bands. Current result or question precedes history. Completed traces show the last two signals by default, with t retaining access to every signal. Result Markdown headings receive their own type hierarchy.

findings.problem: Repeated navigation sequences merged into a tty read lost keys
findings.resolution: Every complete navigation sequence in a read is delivered in order; PTY type helper uses the bracketed-paste protocol enabled by the app.

findings.problem: Full terminal cell-width handling for CJK, combining marks and complex emoji is incomplete in the existing renderer
findings.acceptance_scope: Latin/Cyrillic task prose was reviewed; grapheme-safe editing is tested, full display-width qualification remains.

findings.problem: Keys, action labels and explanatory text merged visually across the interface
findings.resolution: Shared binding renderer with warm bold keys, neutral labels and quiet separators; complete bindings at narrow widths. Applied to task actions, composer, help, search, input, report and diff navigation. Task actions and global navigation no longer repeat one another.

findings.problem: Detailed command receipts buried the written result in real audits
findings.resolution: The task pane shows the reported conclusion, changed files and reported checks together. The full report precedes detailed command receipts; every receipt remains in the review appendix. Markdown headings, inline code, emphasis and links use readable terminal styles.

findings.problem: Split SS3 navigation sequences can insert a literal character instead of moving the cursor
findings.scope: Reproduced against the audited source; not changed by the UI readability pass.

findings.problem: Unframed letter plus Enter in a single tty read is conservatively interpreted as paste and does not submit
findings.scope: The unframed multiline safety heuristic depends on read boundaries. Confirmed as an input reliability limitation; no permission action was exercised.

live_provider.conditional_security_risk: Paste-to-action exposure outside recognized framing remains unverified on a live terminal; not a confirmed vulnerability.

verification.evidence_scope: Aggregate findings are committed; raw captures, tasks and logs remain local in ignored .review/ and .work/ directories.

boundaries: Unsent new-task drafts are kept only for the current TUI session.
Deterministic provider fixtures validate UI and persistence, not real-provider sign-in or model access.
The existing renderer still needs a dedicated full Unicode terminal-cell-width pass for CJK, combining marks and complex emoji; editor movement/deletion is grapheme-aware.
This pass ran on macOS PTYs; Linux, SSH/tmux and screen-reader acceptance were not requalified.
The live qualification covers one real Codex source-audit task. Its two reproduced input reliability findings remain open; it is not a clean security-audit verdict.
source_tui_sha256_algorithm: sha256 of sorted relative path, NUL, file bytes, NUL for src/tui/*.mjs
